responsibility: This header defines the per-candidate bookkeeping structure used by GCC's RTL avoid-store-forwarding pass. Its `store_fwd_info` record captures the original store insn and memory reference, temporary register and save/restore insns needed when a store is moved past a load, the synthesized bit-insertion sequence, the byte offset within the load, and pass-local state such as instruction distance and removal/forwarding flags. It is the internal data model shared by the pass implementation rather than a general RTL API.
same_name_distinction: Defines the pass-local `store_fwd_info` data structure that records candidate stores, temporaries, synthesized repair insns, offsets, and flags. In this same-name pair, the .cc is the actual RTL pass implementation and transformation logic.
